messages.content:
Review these public OSV/GitHub Advisory facts for Maven org.eclipse.jetty:jetty-server and propose concise evidence-backed OSS Security KB updates. Do not fabricate findings; use only facts in the evidence. Group recurring themes and note safe posture/open questions. Evidence:
- GHSA-26vr-8j45-3r4w / BIT-jenkins-2021-28165, CVE-2021-28165: Jetty vulnerable to incorrect handling of invalid large TLS frame, exhausting CPU resources Fixed in: 9.4.39, 10.0.2, 11.0.2. Severity vectors: CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:N/A:H
- GHSA-5h9j-q6j2-253f / CVE-2019-17632: Unescaped exception messages in error responses in Jetty Fixed in: 9.4.24.v20191120. Severity vectors: CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:C/C:L/I:L/A:N
- GHSA-6x9x-8qw9-9pp6 / CVE-2017-7658: Jetty vulnerable to authorization bypass due to inconsistent HTTP request handling (HTTP Request Smuggling) Fixed in: 9.2.25.v20180606, 9.3.24.v20180605, 9.4.11.v20180605. Severity vectors: CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H
- GHSA-7vx9-xjhr-rw6h / CVE-2019-10241: Cross-site Scripting in Eclipse Jetty Fixed in: 9.2.27.v20190403, 9.3.26.v20190403, 9.4.16.v20190411. Severity vectors: CVSS:3.0/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:C/C:L/I:L/A:N
- GHSA-84q7-p226-4x5w / CVE-2017-7656: Jetty vulnerable to cache poisoning due to inconsistent HTTP request handling (HTTP Request Smuggling) Fixed in: 9.3.24.v20180605, 9.4.11.v20180605. Severity vectors: CVSS:3.0/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:H/A:N
- GHSA-86wm-rrjm-8wh8 / BIT-kafka-2020-27218, BIT-spark-2020-27218, CVE-2020-27218: Buffer not correctly recycled in Gzip Request inflation Fixed in: 9.4.35.v20201120. Severity vectors: CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:L/A:L
